subject: Partner technical mentorship & enablement pilot for Meridian Consulting
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Jason Lee <jason.lee@meridian.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner technical mentorship & enablement pilot for Meridian Consulting

Hi Jason —

Thanks again for taking the time on Tuesday. As discussed, Meridian has a clear need to accelerate hands-on capability across your delivery teams so they can confidently scope and implement Redwood-powered solutions for your customers. Rather than a generic slide deck, we propose a four-week "Technical Mentorship + Shadow" pilot that combines focused workshops, paired lab sessions, and direct shadowing on a live customer engagement.

High-level proposed sprint (attached as playbook):
- Week 0: Intake + baseline skills assessment (2 hours)
- Week 1: Architecture deep-dive & Redwood runtime patterns (4 x 90m)
- Week 2: Hands-on lab (pair-programming on a sample integration)
- Week 3: Shadow a real customer delivery (one sprint block)
- Deliverable: Joint runbook + enablement checklist and CS handoff

Benefits we see: faster time-to-first-deploy, reduced support tickets, and a repeatable package Meridian can use for internal training post-pilot. Estimated internal effort: 2 SEs + 1 Partner AE, ~10–12 hours/week.

I've attached a draft playbook and a short QA doc with answers to the questions you asked. If this looks good, can we lock the pilot window the week of May 10? If you prefer, we can start a week earlier.

Thanks —
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Hannah —

Appreciate the clear outline. A few quick questions from our side before we lock dates:
1) Can you confirm which Redwood SEs would be on the engagement and their availability windows?
2) For the shadowing week, we need to ensure NDAs and data access for the customer are in place — any templated docs you can share?
3) Pricing/credits for the pilot — is there a partner discount or time-limited credit for Meridian?

Also, we have a vendor onboarding blackout May 12–14 (end-of-quarter) — would that block the week of May 10 for parts of our delivery team? If so, earliest alternative is May 17.

I'll loop in our Partnerships inbox so they can coordinate paperwork.

Thanks,
Jason

Jason / Partnerships team —

Thanks for the quick questions. Answers inline and attached:

1) SEs & availability: Ben Carter (Week 1 + Labs) and Karthik Iyer (shadowing + runbook) — both available starting May 17. I've attached a short bio for each and a consolidated availability grid.

2) Paperwork: attached a redacted partner NDA + our standard customer onboarding checklist. For shadowing, Meridian will need an MOU that clarifies access levels; we've attached a one-page mentor MOU template for signature.

3) Credits/pricing: Redwood can offer a one-time pilot credit of $4,000. If Meridian converts the pilot into a paid certification program within 90 days, we can convert the credit toward the first cohort at a discounted rate. Laura — can you confirm we can approve the credit on this deal?

Proposed dates: start May 17, baseline assessment Tue May 18 11am PT, architecture workshops May 19–20 (4 sessions), lab week May 24–28, shadowing May 31–June 4.

Jason — if that schedule works I can send a calendar invite + DocuSign for the MOU.

Thanks,
Hannah
